question: In which state is the Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Gandhi Sagar Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Madhya Pradesh, India**
 
• The **sanctuary is spread across the Mandsaur and Nimach districts in the eastern part of the state, and is bordered by Rajasthan.**
 
• It **covers an area of 368.62 square kilometers (142.32 square miles). **
